required_fields: farm_id; validated property geometry; lot volume; traceability type; origin fields
provisional_calculation_rule: 100 * sum(volume_tonnes where traceability_type supports claim and required origin evidence is verified) / sum(all volume_tonnes)
missing_data_rule: missing/unknown lot volume remains in denominator and is not traceable
key_qa_checks: duplicate lots; volume plausibility; origin field and geometry validity
claim_limit: state coverage, traceability model, and denominator

required_fields: cutoff date; validated boundary; change area/date/type; conversion flag; disposition
provisional_calculation_rule: sum(area_ha where natural_ecosystem_conversion_flag=yes and change_end_date > applicable_cutoff_date); status fails if >0 confirmed; pending/uncertain is unresolved
missing_data_rule: missing historical/current evidence or pending alert = unresolved
key_qa_checks: gross not net; all natural ecosystems; boundary/version/date; field-check material alerts
claim_limit: state cutoff, ecosystem scope, coverage, uncertainty

required_fields: legal designation; permit/status; incident/finding status; area
provisional_calculation_rule: fail if material unresolved noncompliance or disturbance; report gross affected area and open actions separately
key_qa_checks: CAR not sole proof; overlapping designations not double counted; official/current source
claim_limit: legal compliance only; not an outcome claim

metric_name: Rights tenure grievance and FPIC screen
required_fields: tenure/right evidence; cases; consent/FPIC; severity; status
provisional_calculation_rule: fail for confirmed rights violation/invalid required consent; unresolved for disputed/missing rights or open high/critical case pending review; count cases by status/severity
key_qa_checks: restricted access; no complaint absence inference; retaliation screen

applicability_trigger: all farms; targeted survey when risk trigger
required_fields: risk/occurrence; threat-list version; action status; hunting/collection/mortality incidents
provisional_calculation_rule: fail for prohibited hunting/collection or unaddressed material harm; report observations and open protection actions without treating no records as absence
missing_data_rule: no occurrence record does not mean absent; missing risk screen = unresolved
key_qa_checks: expert ID; current list; sensitive locations; action closure
claim_limit: protection evidence only unless standardized response survey

required_fields: registration; active ingredient; prohibited flag; buffer/weather; incidents
provisional_calculation_rule: fail if any confirmed prohibited application or unremediated material contamination/buffer breach; count and area separately
key_qa_checks: current prohibited list; purchase/inventory/application reconciliation; incident linkage

metric_name: Native/semi-natural habitat extent and annual loss
calculation_grain: farm x ecosystem class x reporting period
required_fields: property area; polygon class/area; change area/type/confidence
provisional_calculation_rule: extent_pct=100*unique current habitat polygon area/property area; separately sum confirmed gross_loss and gross_gain by ecosystem class
missing_data_rule: unclassified/uncertain area reported separately and excluded from positive extent claim
key_qa_checks: unique non-overlap area; boundary consistency; gross not net; confidence

metric_name: Habitat management plan implementation and condition
required_fields: management plan/actions; raw indicators; method; reference; condition score
provisional_calculation_rule: action completion=100*verified due actions completed/due actions; condition change=current approved score - comparable baseline score; report by ecosystem/polygon
missing_data_rule: no comparable repeat = no condition-change result
key_qa_checks: same method/season/site or documented adjustment; raw-to-score reproducible
claim_limit: action claim and condition claim reported separately

provisional_calculation_rule: report unique protected extent, confirmed gross disturbance, hectares under restoration, survival/condition indicators, and reversals separately
missing_data_rule: missing mapping/required monitoring = unresolved/no positive claim
key_qa_checks: no overlap double count; planted ≠ restored; reversal reported
claim_limit: separate protection, activity, and outcome claims

required_fields: amount; concentration; area; active ingredient; approved toxicity factor; scouting/threshold/decision
provisional_calculation_rule: AI kg/ha=sum(product amount * concentration conversion)/treated area; toxic load=sum(AI mass * approved factor)/managed area; report scouting coverage and decisions; compare like crop/region baseline
safeguard_or_direction: reduce risk and reliance; prohibited rule separate
missing_data_rule: applications without composition/factor reported unknown; not scored as zero
key_qa_checks: units; duplicate apps; treated vs managed area; factor version; purchase/inventory reconciliation

metric_name: Year-round soil cover crop diversity and erosion risk
farm_level_output: cover metrics; crop diversity; erosion incidents
required_fields: field area; crop/date; living/residue/bare cover; method; erosion risk/signs/incidents
provisional_calculation_rule: area-weight approved observations by field; report key-window bare/total cover; count distinct crop/functional groups and valid rotations; report erosion-risk area and incidents separately
missing_data_rule: missing key-window observations = no annual cover result
key_qa_checks: percent/domain; field area; shared-area; observation timing/effort; incident linkage

metric_name: Water-risk screen withdrawal and quality incidents
applicability_trigger: all farms screen; withdrawal where used; quality where risk-triggered
required_fields: risk/permit; withdrawal; method; area/production; quality result/QA/threshold; incidents
provisional_calculation_rule: sum valid withdrawal by source; intensity per irrigated ha and tonne where valid; count exceedances/incidents; quality results only under approved design
missing_data_rule: estimated explicitly; missing permit/required withdrawal data = unresolved
key_qa_checks: meter reconciliation; permit limit; units; source; rejected samples excluded
claim_limit: do not attribute basin change without design

required_fields: polygon/intervention area; sampled/surviving; native cover/richness; condition; reversal
provisional_calculation_rule: survival_pct=100*sum(surviving)/sum(sampled) for comparable cohorts; report intervention area, condition change, and reversal area separately
missing_data_rule: planted/intervention area cannot substitute for missing survival/condition
key_qa_checks: cohort/age/method; sample size; area; reversal/incident linkage
claim_limit: do not call area restored from intervention alone

farm_level_output: farm habitat inputs; approved landscape index

provisional_calculation_rule: calculate only with approved transparent landscape method; report farm-controlled habitat/corridor area and index change separately
missing_data_rule: no index without complete method-required landscape inputs
key_qa_checks: geometry/topology/date; method version; external vs participant change; leakage

applicability_trigger: material freshwater risk and approved monitoring design

provisional_calculation_rule: report valid raw results and exceedances; calculate trend/comparison only under approved repeated/comparator design
missing_data_rule: rejected/missing samples excluded and coverage disclosed

provisional_calculation_rule: retain raw repeat detections; estimate occupancy/diversity only using pre-approved detection-aware analysis with sufficient repeats/sample
missing_data_rule: missing repeat/effort prevents occupancy claim; zeros retained only from valid surveys

provisional_calculation_rule: use approved pilot method; report raw values and change only for comparable samples; no universal score specified

safeguard_or_direction: reduce priority invasive pressure without harm
